Container.Name: IPTV Tunerr
Container.Overview: IPTV to Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin: HDHomeRun-emulating tuner, custom merged XMLTV guide, resilient stream gateway, DVR and recording rules, VOD libraries, and an operator dashboard.
Container.Description: IPTV Tunerr turns IPTV providers and M3U sources into a polished live TV backend for Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin.[br][br][b]Sources:[/b] M3U and Xtream player_api (live, movies, series); multiple providers merged and de-duplicated with backup-stream failover; host probing and ranking; optional stream smoketest.[br][b]HDHomeRun emulation:[/b] discover.json, lineup.json, and lineup_status.json with a tuner-count limit, wizard-safe channel caps, lineup sharding, and per-instance numbering; also reads real HDHomeRun hardware.[br][b]Custom guide:[/b] layered XMLTV (provider, external, HDHomeRun, placeholder) with automatic EPG matching and repair, alias overrides, language preferences, and guide-health and EPG-doctor reports.[br][b]Stream gateway:[/b] HLS and DASH to MPEG-TS relay, optional ffmpeg remux or transcode with named profiles, shared sessions across viewers, failover, and Cloudflare-block resilience.[br][b]DVR and recording:[/b] catch-up capsules, recording rules and history, and request-driven recording for apps such as SeerrNG.[br][b]Lineup tools:[/b] Programming Manager, channel health scoring, lineup recipes, virtual channels, and API-Sports sports schedules.[br][b]VOD:[/b] movie and series catalog exposed over a FUSE mount or read-only WebDAV, with Plex library registration.[br][b]Plex tools:[/b] automatic DVR and channel registration, stale-session cleanup, and an optional Live TV entitlement proxy for shared users.[br][b]Operations:[/b] authenticated web dashboard, Prometheus metrics, event webhooks, health endpoints, and an Xtream-compatible output. Keep tuner ports on a trusted LAN or VPN.

Container.Changes: Initial Community Applications template. Tracks the GHCR latest image published by the IPTV Tunerr release workflow.
Container.Requires: Persistent appdata and cache paths. Set a reachable IPTV_TUNERR_BASE_URL before using Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin.

Config.Name: Tuner Port
Config.Description: HTTP tuner, stream, playlist, and guide endpoint. Keep this on a trusted LAN or VPN.

Config.Name: Operator Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Authenticated Tunerr operator dashboard. Do not expose this port publicly.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Persistent guide and provider caches. This directory can grow with provider data.

Config.Name: Dashboard State File
Config.Description: Persistent operator dashboard preferences and state.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Required URL that Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin can reach, including the host port if remapped (for example http://192.168.1.20:5004).

Config.Name: M3U URL
Config.Description: Optional M3U source URL. Treat URLs containing credentials as secrets.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Optional Plex Media Server URL for automatic tuner registration.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Optional Plex token for automatic tuner registration.

Config.Name: API-Sports Key
Config.Description: Optional server-side API-Sports key for Sports Automation.

Config.Name: Dashboard Password
Config.Description: Required strong password for the operator dashboard.

Config.Name: Dashboard LAN Access
Config.Description: Allow the authenticated dashboard to accept connections on the mapped LAN port.
